candidates.source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije (ZBS) – About us / Organi (governance page)
candidates.why_relevant: Publishes the dated composition of the ZBS Supervisory Board (13 members + 13 deputies), each seat held by a named senior executive of a member bank (e.g. chairman from NLB, deputies from Delavska hranilnica and OTP banka). A change of the person occupying a bank's seat is a near-real-time proxy for a CEO/board change at that bank.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled HTML snapshot + diff of the board roster table (name, deputy, institution); the page carries an 'as of' date, so diff on that date field too. Fetch the Slovenian twin page in parallel.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + direct fetch of association site

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovenian fintech trade association could be located. Searches in both sl and en for 'Združenje FinTech Slovenija', 'Slovenian Fintech Association', 'Zavod Fintech' and 'fintech združenje članstvo' returned no such organisation — only a same-named private company (FINTECH d.o.o.), the Slovak FinTech association, and unrelated bodies.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovenia appears to lack a standalone fintech association; the nearest functional substitutes are Blockchain Alliance Europe, the Slovenian Digital Coalition blockchain working group, and GZS ZIT.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's seed assumption of a 'Slovenian Fintech association' as a leadership/member index does not hold; fintech leadership signals must be reconstructed from adjacent bodies and from startup-ecosystem channels instead.

negative_findings.description: No GZS branch association or section specifically for financial services / fintech was found. GZS's 26 branch associations include ZIT (ICT) but searches for 'sekcija za finančne storitve' returned nothing matching.
negative_findings.result_summary: Banking is represented in Slovenia by ZBS (a separate GIZ), not by a GZS section — so GZS is a general-economy source in this cell, not a banking one.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids wasted crawl budget hunting a non-existent GZS finance section, and confirms ZBS as the single sector-specific chamber-equivalent for banking.

negative_findings.description: A direct fetch of the Slovenian-language governance path https://www.zbs-giz.si/o-zbs/ returned HTTP 404. The English equivalent /en/about-zbs/ fetched successfully and carried the full dated board roster.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as a URL-pattern/hypothesis error, NOT as a dead site — the sl site is very likely live under a different slug that was not discovered in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The Slovenian-language pages may be more current or more detailed than the English ones; the correct sl slug should be resolved from the site's own navigation before the collector is configured.

negative_findings.description: The GZS ZIT page /vsebina/Sekcije-Projekti surfaced in search results with an injected spam title in a foreign language (an APK/login spam string), suggesting the page or its index entry has been compromised or defaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Content on that specific GZS subpage is not trustworthy as-fetched.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any automated ingest of GZS branch-association subpages needs a content-sanity gate, or the corpus will absorb spam text as if it were chamber content.

negative_findings.description: No association in this cell was found to publish a dedicated careers/zaposlitve page for its own secretariat. Secretariat hiring signals appear only incidentally (LinkedIn posts, register headcount, press releases).
negative_findings.result_summary: The 'associations as employers' half of the cell rationale is served only indirectly.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Secretariat hiring — the agenda-shift signal — must be inferred from EU Transparency Register FTE figures, AJPES filings and LinkedIn rather than from a scrapeable jobs feed.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovenian-language versions of several association governance pages (notably ZBS) were not resolved to working URLs in this pass; findings lean on the English mirrors, which may lag.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl each association's sl site map / top navigation to resolve canonical sl slugs for organi, članice and novice, then register the sl page as the primary and en as the fallback.

coverage_gaps.description: Association committees below board level (ZBS working committees for payments, AML, ESG, digital euro) were not enumerated — they are the layer where operational bank leaders sit and where sector-agenda shifts appear earliest.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch the ZBS committees/odbori and delovne skupine pages directly and, if not published, request the committee list from ZBS or reconstruct it from Bankers' Day and consultation-response signatories.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival/historical view of association board composition was established, so a diff-based collector starting now cannot date changes that occurred before it was deployed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Seed the store with Wayback Machine snapshots of the ZBS, GZS, AmCham, ZNS and AHK governance pages over the past 5–10 years to build a retrospective roster timeline.

coverage_gaps.description: The highest-velocity appointment and secretariat-hiring channel (LinkedIn association pages) cannot be collected automatically under its ToS.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Budget for manual analyst review of a fixed list of ~8 association LinkedIn pages, or procure a licensed professional-network data feed.

coverage_gaps.description: Bilateral chambers other than AmCham and AHK (British-Slovenian, French, Italian, Nordic) and the employers' association ZDS (Združenje delodajalcev Slovenije) were not searched in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a second sweep on 'britansko-slovenska gospodarska zbornica', 'Združenje delodajalcev Slovenije organi', 'italijansko-slovenska zbornica' and check each for financial-sector board seats and member banks.

brief: Slovenia's association layer for banking and payments is unusually concentrated: Združenje bank Slovenije (ZBS, a GIZ) is effectively the only sector chamber, and its About/Organi page publishes a dated 13-member supervisory board in which each seat is held by a named executive of a member bank — making it a compact, high-credibility index of senior banking leadership, with its Members page serving as the authoritative employer population for all downstream SI collection. Around it sit general and bilateral chambers (GZS and its ZIT branch, AmCham Slovenia, AHK Slovenija, OZS) and profession-level bodies (Združenje nadzornikov Slovenije, Združenje Manager, ZPFS, ACI Slovenia, SZZ, ZDU-GIZ), all of which publish dated board rosters and election press releases in Slovenian, typically mirrored on the O-STA wire and in Delo/RTV SLO/Siol/N1. The notable negative is that no dedicated Slovenian fintech association exists and GZS has no financial-services section — fintech leadership signal must be reconstructed from Blockchain Alliance Europe, the Slovenian Digital Coalition's blockchain working group and GZS ZIT. Associations as employers are weakly served: none publishes a careers feed, so secretariat hiring must be inferred from EU Transparency Register FTE declarations, AJPES/Bizi register profiles and (manually only) LinkedIn.
